events.verdict: Collins (UTA) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Podziemski's (GSW) possession. Any ensuing contact is incidental.
Hield (GSW) briefly places and removes his hand from Collier's (UTA) right arm and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
George (UTA) and Curry (GSW) engage and disengage off-ball and the contact is marginal.
Curry (GSW) brings his right forearm to George's (UTA) front and marginal contact occurs as Curry releases away from the defender during his step-back move.
George (UTA) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.

While trailing Clarkson (UTA) off-ball, Hield (GSW) steps behind the offensive player and incidental foot to foot contact occurs, which causes HIeld to temporarily lose his balance and fall to the floor.
Hield (GSW) legally contests Clarkson's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Podziemski (GSW) establishes himself in a legal screening position and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the screen on George (UTA).
Collier (UTA) legally contests Curry's (GSW) layup attempt at the basket.
Hield (GSW) makes illegal contact to Clarkson's (UTA) left arm prior to his gather and upward shooting motion.
Kessler (UTA) cleanly blocks Green's (GSW) layup attempt and the ensuing body contact is incidental.
Post (GSW) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Green (GSW) and George (UTA) engage and disengage off-ball and the contact is marginal.
George (UTA) raises his hand towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Curry's (GSW) right arm after the release of his driving shot attempt.
Collier (UTA) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Green (GSW) commits a take foul on George (UTA).
Clarkson (UTA) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Payton II (GSW) extends his hands into Collins (UTA), causing him to lose his balance.
Kessler (UTA) raises his left hand towards the ball and incidental contact occurs with part of Green's (GSW) hand that is on the ball, which legally deflects it during Green's pass attempt.
